# emoji-kit

Package: emoji-kit
Install: npm install emoji-kit
Requirement: Node.js 18+
License: MIT for emoji-kit; every raw artwork/license record carries its upstream license.

## Use the package

emoji-kit provides Unicode emoji lookup, shortcode/search/list, plain-text rendering, app overlays, isolated kits, and the v0.2 offline raw-resource catalog.

ESM:
```js
import emoji, {
  get, search, list, renderText,
  getResource, listResources, resolveResource,
  resources, resourceSources, resourceCatalog,
} from 'emoji-kit';

emoji('thumbsup');
get('thumbsup');
search('thumbs up', { limit: 5 });
list({ app: 'github', limit: 5 });
renderText('Hi :thumbsup:');

const record = resolveResource({ sourceId: 'wechat-community-png', format: 'png' });
const matches = listResources({ app: 'weibo', format: 'png', limit: 3 });
console.log(resourceCatalog.counts, resources.length, resourceSources.length);
```

Core entry: `emoji-kit/core` exports the same core Unicode API and resource APIs.
Data-only entry: `emoji-kit/data` exports `resources`, `resourceSources`, and `resourceCatalog`; it also exports `emojis`, `aliases`, `apps`, `assets`, and `metadata`. It provides no functions.
Existing React, apps, and CLI exports remain: `emoji-kit/react`, `emoji-kit/apps`, `emoji-kit/cli`, and the `emoji-kit` binary. There is no `emoji-kit/resources` subpath and no `resources` CLI command in v0.2.

CommonJS:
```js
const { getResource, listResources, resolveResource } = require('emoji-kit');
```

## Offline catalog behavior

Lookup is synchronous and pure. It reads only the checked-in static catalog and never fetches, reads the filesystem, or reads environment variables. Use `getResource` for exact id/path/url lookup, `resolveResource` for exact lookup or filter-only first-match lookup, and `listResources` for filtered lists (AND filters, path order, default limit 20, maximum 500).

Example:
```js
resolveResource('twemoji-svg:1f44d.svg')
resolveResource({ app: 'native', format: 'svg' })
listResources({ app: 'wechat', format: 'png', limit: 5 })
```

## Provenance and fetching

Catalog counts: 8 sources, 17,026 files, 17,018 assets, 8 license records, 190371148 bytes. App-specific saved artwork currently covers `douyin`, `tiktok`, `wechat`, and `weibo`; native saved artwork covers `native`. This catalog is community/provenance metadata, not official app data. The WeChat and Weibo collections are GPL-3.0 community collections and are not official or affiliated with their respective platforms.

Count semantics: `resourceCatalog.counts` totals include license records (`counts.files` = `counts.assets` + `counts.licenses`, and `counts.totalBytes` includes license files). Per-source `resourceCatalog.sources[].fileCount` and `totalBytes` are artwork-only and exclude the separate license file; use `assetCount` + `licenseCount` or `resourceCatalog.counts` when you need totals across all files.

A record contains `url`, `ref`, `sha256`, `bytes`, `license`, `repository`, `sourceId`, and `path`. Do not reconstruct URLs or use branches/latest refs. Fetch `record.url` only as an explicit caller action, then verify downloaded bytes with SHA-256 against `record.sha256`. Respect `record.license` and upstream terms.

## Repository-only agent artifacts

Do not look for llms.txt, docs, or examples inside node_modules/emoji-kit. The v0.2 npm tarball ships the programmatic API and catalog only, not repository agent documentation or examples. Fetch repository artifacts from pinned raw URLs at the emoji-kit commit shown below.

Pinned emoji-kit repository commit: 76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe
- llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/llms.txt
- Agent guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/docs/agents.md
- Resource contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/docs/agent-resource-contract.md
- API reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/docs/api.md
- Catalog example: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/examples/agent-catalog.mjs
- Fetch example: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqs1qiwan/emoji/76e75e8dbffb9e330bf542aecece904a4bc0aebe/examples/fetch-resource.mjs

Always verify the pinned commit corresponds to the package version before relying on documentation. Raw upstream artwork URLs come from each catalog record and are pinned by upstream commit; they are separate from the emoji-kit repository commit.
